# Local face framing models

`lbpcascade_animeface.xml` (246,945 bytes) is the original model from
[nagadomi/lbpcascade_animeface](https://github.com/nagadomi/lbpcascade_animeface),
downloaded on 2026-11-09 from
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nagadomi/lbpcascade_animeface/master/lbpcascade_animeface.xml.

It is distributed under the MIT License, copyright 2011 nagadomi@nurs.or.jp.
The complete original license is preserved in the XML header. The unmodified
upstream README is included as `lbpcascade_animeface.README.md`.

For photographic faces, the application also uses the frontal-face Haar model
already bundled with the installed OpenCV package. No model downloads occur
during artwork display. Detection describes visible faces, not character names
or narrative importance. Missing detections use a neutral centre.
